'''Anora''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was the girlfriend of [[Vector Hyllus]] until he became a [[Joiner]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Anora sent Vector a [[Holomessage/Legends|holomessage]], pleading him to return to her and undo the joining process, but after contemplation Vector decided that he enjoyed his current situation better.
